name: Mediterranean Ground Beef and Cabbage Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided
1 small green cabbage, cored and shredded
2 scallions, trimmed and chopped (both whites and green parts)
unmapped: baharat (Middle Eastern warm-spice blend; no board id - closest analog is shawarma-spice-blend but not equivalent; this is the signature spice and a genuine new-commodity flag for the pricer lane)
why: Ground beef + shredded cabbage + carrots seared in a skillet, spiced with baharat/cumin/coriander - structurally low-carb (no rice/pasta/potato/bread) and Middle Eastern, adding cuisine variety to a catalog that skews American/Tex-Mex. Published nutrition 418.5 cal / 21.6g carbs / 26.8g protein clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band on the source's own numbers. Big skillet, weigh-and-divide, scales cleanly to 14. CONFIDENCE/FLAGS: (1) calories sit near the 400 floor - if our label-DB macros drift down it risks failing our own gate; (2) potential near-duplicate of the existing beef-unstuffed-cabbage-skillet (this differs by Middle Eastern spicing, carrots, and no tomato base) - flagged for the dedup adjudicators to rule. baharat flagged unmapped per the pricer-lane exercise.
